answer_text:
Connecting support to your CRM means agents see deal and account context on every ticket. Options that do this well:

1. Brightdesk - strong reporting and automations, though the interface feels dated.
2. Northwind CRM Service Desk - its service module links tickets to accounts, at enterprise prices.
3. Pipewell - not built for support; you'd pair it with a separate help desk.

If support is your main workflow, go with Brightdesk; otherwise Northwind CRM keeps things simpler.
